study: exploratory action-location conditioning of a 16x16 research visual transition model
model_change: The spatial_global architecture broadcasts normalized x/y action coordinates over every spatial cell in addition to the existing local click locus and action type. It does not change the live UiJepaPredictor.

rejected_development_trials.simple_coordinate_linear: On controlled pairs, correct-action weighted MSE 0.03835 was worse than action-ablated 0.03292.
rejected_development_trials.paired_ranking_loss: On Heliox light eval, correct-action weighted MSE 0.59354 and swapped 0.59341 were essentially indistinguishable.
rejected_development_trials.photometric_augmentation: On the 16-row dark transfer diagnostic, correct-action weighted MSE rose to 1.10563 against unchanged-state 0.00599.

interpretation: Broadcast coordinates fix a receptive-field limitation and show action sensitivity in two small same-environment studies. The severe appearance-shift failure rejects runtime promotion. These development-selected checks are not independent application transfer, multi-step world modeling, safety validation, or Jev parity. Weights remain ignored local research artifacts.
